label: AI model
description: The AI “brain” (Claude, GPT, Gemini, a local model…) that AI steps use to think and write. One model block can power several steps. Technical: init_chat_model("provider:model").

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: Plug this into the “model” input of an Ask AI step, an agent, or an add-on that needs a model.

model.title: Model
model.description: provider:model, e.g. anthropic:claude-sonnet-5-5, openai:gpt-5.5, ollama:llama3.3, lmstudio:<model>

base_url.title: Base URL
base_url.description: The provider's server address; for local servers (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp) only when not on the default port

api_key.title: API key (secret reference)
api_key.description: A project secret holding the key. Empty: the project secret or server variable named after the provider (e.g. OPENAI_API_KEY)
